info.name: Petproject - Full End-to-End Business Flow
info.description: Complete real-world E2E workflow covering all 14 microservices: Auth -> Catalog -> Inventory -> Cart -> Order -> Payment -> Shipping -> Rating -> Favourite -> Search -> Notification -> Tax -> Promotion -> Media -> Gateway.

item.name: 12.2 Regular User Tries to Create Product (expect 403)

exec: pm.test("Rejects regular user product creation with 403", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(403));

item.name: 13.1 Add Item to Cart with Zero Quantity (expect 400/422)
13.2 Add Item to Cart for Non-Existent Product (expect 404)

exec: pm.test("Returns 404 for non-existent product in cart", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(404));
